// Prints TypeScript's `keepManualEdits` goldens for rust-manual "Manual keep
// equals TypeScript's" and "Manual refusals equal TypeScript's".
// Run from the repository root after `pnpm build`:
//   node print-goldens.mjs <fixture project> <golden folder>
// <golden folder> holds `cases.json`; the script writes `<case>.txt` beside it.
//
// Each case starts from a fresh scratch folder. It copies the fixture project
// to the project root and writes the project's `osq.toml` from the case's
// `vcs`, with `author = "osq <osq@example.com>"`. With `git` `root` the
// project root is the scratch folder; with `parent` it is `<scratch>/project`
// and the scratch folder is the repository; with `none` there is no
// repository. A repository is `git init -b main` with the local config
// `user.name Ada`, `user.email ada@example.com` and `commit.gpgsign false`,
// and one commit of every file. The case's steps then run in order:
//   write   writes `text` to the path, making its folders
//   append  appends `text` to the path
//   remove  deletes the path
//   move    runs `git mv <move> <to>`
//   config  runs `git config <config> <value>`
//   hook    writes `.git/hooks/<hook>` as `#!/bin/sh\nexit 1\n`, mode 755
// Then it runs `keepManualEdits` with the case's comment and paths, `now`
// 2026-10-15T20:01:02.123Z, and the config `defineConfig` makes of the same
// `vcs` block.
//
// `<case>.txt` holds, one section after another:
//   exit: 0 when it returned, 1 when it threw
//   lines: each returned line, a 7-hex short commit written `<commit>`
//   error: the thrown message, with the project root written `<root>` and the
//          repository top written `<top>`; a case with `gitRefuses` writes
//          `<commit refused>` instead, since git's own text differs by version
//   head: `new` when HEAD moved, `unchanged` when not, `none` with no repository
//   message: the new commit's raw message, `git log -1 --format=%B`
//   author: the new commit's `%an <%ae>`
//   files: the new commit's `git show --name-status --format=` lines
//   records: each file under `openspec/manual/`, sorted, as `== <name>` and
//            its text without its final newline
//   status: `git status --porcelain=v1 --untracked-files=all` after the run
// A section with nothing to show holds no lines. The file ends with a newline.
import { spawnSync } from 'node:child_process';
import fs from 'node:fs';
import os from 'node:os';
import path from 'node:path';
import { pathToFileURL } from 'node:url';

const dist = (file) => pathToFileURL(path.resolve('dist', file)).href;
const { defineConfig } = await import(dist('core/foundation/config.js'));
const { keepManualEdits } = await import(dist('core/vcs/manual-edits.js'));

const [fixture, golden] = process.argv.slice(2);
const cases = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(path.join(golden, 'cases.json'), 'utf8'));
const AUTHOR = 'osq <osq@example.com>';
const NOW = '2026-10-15T20:01:02.123Z';

function git(cwd, args) {
  const result = spawnSync('git', args, { cwd, encoding: 'utf8' });
  if (result.status !== 0) throw new Error(`git ${args.join(' ')}: ${result.stderr}`);
  return result.stdout;
}

function toml(vcs) {
  const lines = ['[vcs]', `enabled = ${vcs.enabled}`, `author = "${AUTHOR}"`];
  if (vcs.manualEdits !== undefined) lines.push(`manualEdits = "${vcs.manualEdits}"`);
  return `${lines.join('\n')}\n`;
}

function runStep(root, top, step) {
  if (step.write !== undefined) {
    fs.mkdirSync(path.dirname(path.join(root, step.write)), { recursive: true });
    fs.writeFileSync(path.join(root, step.write), step.text);
  } else if (step.append !== undefined) {
    fs.appendFileSync(path.join(root, step.append), step.text);
  } else if (step.remove !== undefined) {
    fs.rmSync(path.join(root, step.remove));
  } else if (step.move !== undefined) {
    git(root, ['mv', step.move, step.to]);
  } else if (step.config !== undefined) {
    git(root, ['config', step.config, step.value]);
  } else if (step.hook !== undefined) {
    const hook = path.join(top, '.git', 'hooks', step.hook);
    fs.mkdirSync(path.dirname(hook), { recursive: true });
    fs.writeFileSync(hook, '#!/bin/sh\nexit 1\n', { mode: 0o755 });
  } else {
    throw new Error(`unknown step ${JSON.stringify(step)}`);
  }
}

function setUp(scratch, entry) {
  const root = entry.git === 'parent' ? path.join(scratch, 'project') : scratch;
  fs.cpSync(fixture, root, { recursive: true });
  fs.writeFileSync(path.join(root, 'osq.toml'), toml(entry.vcs));
  if (entry.git !== 'none') {
    git(scratch, ['init', '-q', '-b', 'main']);
    git(scratch, ['config', 'user.name', 'Ada']);
    git(scratch, ['config', 'user.email', 'ada@example.com']);
    git(scratch, ['config', 'commit.gpgsign', 'false']);
    git(scratch, ['add', '-A']);
    git(scratch, ['commit', '-q', '-m', 'init']);
  }
  return root;
}

function records(root) {
  const dir = path.join(root, 'openspec', 'manual');
  if (!fs.existsSync(dir)) return [];
  return fs
    .readdirSync(dir)
    .sort()
    .flatMap((name) => {
      const text = fs.readFileSync(path.join(dir, name), 'utf8').replace(/\n$/, '');
      return [`== ${name}`, ...text.split('\n')];
    });
}

async function render(entry) {
  const scratch = fs.realpathSync(fs.mkdtempSync(path.join(os.tmpdir(), `osq-manual-${entry.name}-`)));
  try {
    const root = setUp(scratch, entry);
    for (const step of entry.steps) runStep(root, scratch, step);
    const hasGit = entry.git !== 'none';
    const before = hasGit ? git(scratch, ['rev-parse', 'HEAD']).trim() : null;
    const vcs = { enabled: entry.vcs.enabled, author: AUTHOR };
    if (entry.vcs.manualEdits !== undefined) vcs.manualEdits = entry.vcs.manualEdits;
    const config = defineConfig({ vcs });

    let exit = 0;
    let lines = [];
    let error = [];
    try {
      lines = await keepManualEdits(root, config, { comment: entry.comment, paths: entry.paths, now: NOW });
      lines = lines.map((line) => line.replace(/ as [0-9a-f]{7}$/, ' as <commit>'));
    } catch (thrown) {
      exit = 1;
      const message = entry.gitRefuses === true
        ? '<commit refused>'
        : String(thrown.message).replaceAll(root, '<root>').replaceAll(scratch, '<top>');
      error = [message];
    }

    const after = hasGit ? git(scratch, ['rev-parse', 'HEAD']).trim() : null;
    const head = !hasGit ? 'none' : after === before ? 'unchanged' : 'new';
    const moved = head === 'new';
    const out = [`exit: ${exit}`, 'lines:', ...lines, 'error:', ...error, `head: ${head}`, 'message:'];
    if (moved) out.push(...git(scratch, ['log', '-1', '--format=%B']).replace(/\n+$/, '').split('\n'));
    out.push('author:');
    if (moved) out.push(git(scratch, ['log', '-1', '--format=%an <%ae>']).trim());
    out.push('files:');
    if (moved) out.push(...git(scratch, ['show', '--name-status', '--format=', 'HEAD']).trim().split('\n'));
    out.push('records:', ...records(root), 'status:');
    if (hasGit) {
      const status = git(scratch, ['status', '--porcelain=v1', '--untracked-files=all']).replace(/\n+$/, '');
      if (status !== '') out.push(...status.split('\n'));
    }
    fs.writeFileSync(path.join(golden, `${entry.name}.txt`), `${out.join('\n')}\n`);
  } finally {
    fs.rmSync(scratch, { recursive: true, force: true });
  }
}

for (const entry of cases) await render(entry);
